0022600129.text: The Knicks (0-3, 12th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic) host the Pistons (3-0, 1st in the East and the Central) in New York's fourth game of the season, with New York on a three-game losing streak and Detroit on a three-game winning streak. New York will be without Jose Alvarado, who is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain) and has Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. There have been no meetings between the teams yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks lost all three games to the Pistons in 2025-26, most recently 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026.
